headline: Nevish Line Falls to Colonials; Callahan's Passage Sealed by Wardens
war_summary: The Nevish Line has gone over in the space of the last watch. The three Warden works reported there in the previous edition are gone; the sector now reads seven Colonial, one unclaimed and none Warden, and the guns are still speaking, with twenty-four actions in six hours and five in the last two, thickest about Grief Mother, Unruly and the Scrying Belt. Callahan's Passage, which stood with one work unclaimed, is now wholly Warden at ten after nineteen actions in the day; Crumbling Post bore the brunt and the sector has since fallen quiet. Mooring County has yielded a work to the Colonials, who now hold two of twelve against ten Warden, and its casualty rolls are the heaviest on the map, near five thousand a side in the day. Linn Mercy holds at ten Colonial and one unclaimed following nine actions in six hours; the Weathered Expanse stands at seven Warden and two unclaimed, silent these six hours but carrying thirty-nine actions in the day. Marban Hollow remains four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed. Colonial holdings remain the greater across the map.
